properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued August 9 at 5:48AM CDT until August 9 at 12:00PM CDT by NWS Des Moines IA
properties.description:
FFWDMX

The National Weather Service in Des Moines has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Northwestern Webster County in central Iowa...

* Until noon CDT Sunday.

* At 548 AM CDT, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing
heavy rain across the warned area. Between 3 and 4 inches of rain
have fallen. Flash flooding is ongoing or expected to begin
shortly.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by thunderstorms.

SOURCE...Radar.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, urban
areas, highways, streets and underpasses as well as
other poor drainage and low-lying areas.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Western portions of Fort Dodge, Lizard Creek, and Clare.
properties.instruction:
For the latest stream observations and forecasts refer to
weather.gov/desmoines/water.

Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

properties.areaDesc: Coastal waters from South Santee River to Edisto Beach SC out 20 NM; Coastal waters from Edisto Beach SC to Savannah GA out 20 NM
properties.headline: Special Marine Warning issued August 9 at 8:09AM EDT until August 9 at 10:15AM EDT by NWS Charleston SC
properties.description:
SMWCHS

The National Weather Service in Charleston has issued a

* Special Marine Warning for...
Waters from South Santee River SC to Savannah GA out 20 NM...

* Until 1015 AM EDT.

* At 809 AM EDT, severe thunderstorms capable of producing
waterspouts were located along a line from over Bull Breakers to
near Channel Buoy 5, moving southeast at 5 knots.

HAZARD...Waterspouts and wind gusts to 34 knots.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Waterspouts can easily overturn boats and create locally
hazardous seas. Small craft could be damaged in briefly
higher winds and suddenly higher waves.

* Locations impacted include...
Lowcountry Anglers, Kiawah Reef, N. Edisto Nearshore Reef, Edisto
Sixty Reef, Deveaux Bank, Charleston Harbor Entrance, Air Force
Reef, Charleston Nearshore Reef, Charleston Sixty, Joe Shuford
Reef, Charleston Coastal Anglers, Edisto Forty Reef, Rattlesnake
Shoal, Capers Island Buoy and Capers Reef.
properties.instruction:
Move to safe harbor until hazardous weather passes.

Thunderstorms can produce sudden waterspouts. Waterspouts can easily
overturn boats and create locally hazardous seas. Seek safe harbor
immediately.

properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued August 9 at 7:41AM CDT until August 9 at 8:15AM CDT by NWS La Crosse WI
properties.description:
SVRARX

The National Weather Service in La Crosse has issued a

* Severe Thunderstorm Warning for...
Northwestern Juneau County in central Wisconsin...
Northeastern Monroe County in west central Wisconsin...

* Until 815 AM CDT.

* At 741 AM CDT, a severe thunderstorm was located near Tomah, moving
east at 30 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts and quarter size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Hail damage to vehicles is expected. Expect wind damage
to roofs, siding, and trees.

* This severe thunderstorm will be near...
Tomah around 745 AM CDT.

Other locations impacted by this severe thunderstorm include Warrens,
The Necedah Wildlife Refuge, Normay Ridge, Oakdale, Volk Field,
Tunnel City, and Cutler.

This includes the following highways...
Interstate 94 between mile markers 133 and 147.
Interstate 90/94 between mile markers 46 and 61.
Interstate 90 in Wisconsin between mile markers 43 and 45.
properties.instruction:
For your protection move to an interior room on the lowest floor of a
building.
